priority.override_reason: The rank-1 recursive direct-leaf frame-stack and rank-2 repeated-eval mechanisms are closed by 2026-07-27 fast-gate evidence. Ranks 3 and 4 share a distinct, currently profiled constructor-body cost: simple statically named receiver writes still enter the general function environment and VM. One general constructor write plan tests both independent JetStream workloads without selecting by workload source.

mechanism.summary: Execute a prevalidated base or ordinary constructor body made only of ordered `this.<static name> = parameter-or-primitive` writes without constructing a function VM.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility is derived only from immutable bytecode, constructor mode, and live ordinary-object property semantics. It does not inspect benchmark paths, source names, checksums, or iteration counts. Derived constructors and every body outside the complete straight-line shape retain the existing call path.
semantic_risks: preserving ordered public-field initialization before the constructor body
falling back before any write when a receiver or prototype can observe Set through an accessor, Proxy, non-writable descriptor, or non-extensible object
preserving Reflect.construct receiver/prototype behavior and base-versus-derived constructor rules
keeping parameter omission, primitive constants, and implicit undefined return behavior identical

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-27 /tmp/qjs-profile-raytrace.sample; hash-verified JetStream raytrace-public-class-fields bundle
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Base-class construction repeatedly traverses construct_function, class field initialization, general function environment setup, and VM execution for bodies dominated by statically named receiver writes.
